name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: 49 PLA aircraft around Taiwan in a day; no large-scale drill announced
state: Taiwan's defence ministry detected 49 Chinese military aircraft, six warships and six government vessels in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 3 Nov; an analyst called it a 'silent drill', but no exercise was announced (Taipei Times, 4 Nov). China's pause on rare-earth export controls ends on 10 Nov. Normal holds until a declared large-scale exercise or incident.
for_you: No direct effect now; a Taiwan crisis would hit electronics supply chains and Asian travel. Check FCDO advice before travel.
rubric_hit: Routine PLA activity, no declared large-scale exercise = Normal

sources.title: Taipei Times — Heightened Chinese activity detected

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
